verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents its own data-transfer paths: the CLI hello-world workflow includes a 'copy data' step, SSH is documented for file transfer, Jupyter direct connections are described as faster for uploads and downloads, and data can be copied off stopped instances. Community reports of poor instance bandwidth weaken the 'efficiently' part of the story but do not contradict that the tooling exists. missing for 10: S3-compatible endpoints, cloud-storage sync, detailed docs for the transfer commands themselves, independent corroboration of transfer performance.

support.subject: As a developer, I can move data in and out efficiently — S3-compatible endpoints, cloud-storage sync, or documented transfer tooling

citations.quote: search for a GPU, rent it, wait for it to boot, connect to it, copy data, and clean up
Transfer files without exposing your data
This preferred option will establish a direct connection to the instance which is faster for uploading and downloading files from your local machine.
While an instance is stopped, your instance is detached from its GPU(s), but your data can still be copied off the machine.
